info.title: legacy-wrapper
info.description: CLI tool that wraps legacy .NET Framework applications for cloud deployment without modifying the original code — analyzes compatibility, packages binaries as NuGet packages, and generates a modern .NET wrapper host.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Legacy Wrapper — wrap .NET Framework apps for cloud deployment without modifying original code

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print full exception details (type, stack trace, inner exceptions) on failure

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Write a copy of all output, including full exception details, to the given file

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a legacy .NET Framework solution for compatibility

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the legacy .sln file

options.name: --report
options.description: Output path for the report file (default: COMPATIBILITY-REPORT in current directory)

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format: html, json, md, all

options.name: --show-remediable
options.description: Show which diagnostics can be auto-remediated with --remediate

commands.name: package
commands.description: Build legacy solution and package compiled binaries as NuGet packages

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the legacy .sln file

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for NuGet packages

options.name: --skip-build
options.description: Skip the legacy solution build step (assumes binaries already compiled)

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration

options.name: --rewrite-il
options.description: Rewrite IL in legacy assemblies to redirect blocked API calls to bridge methods

options.name: --max-projects
options.description: Maximum number of projects for per-project packaging. When exceeded, all assemblies are bundled into a single aggregate NuGet package. Use 0 to disable the limit.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Scaffold a modern .NET 10 wrapper solution referencing packaged legacy binaries

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the legacy .sln file

options.name: --packages
options.description: Path to the local NuGet packages directory

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the wrapper solution

options.name: --remediate
options.description: Auto-remediate known incompatibilities by generating bridge/shim classes

options.name: --di-overrides
options.description: Generate DI adapter classes that substitute bridge implementations (implies --remediate)

options.name: --ai-provider
options.description: AI provider for generating adapter code: 'anthropic' or 'openai'

options.name: --ai-api-key
options.description: API key for AI provider (defaults to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY env var)

options.name: --max-projects
options.description: Maximum number of projects for per-project packaging. When exceeded, the wrapper references a single aggregate NuGet package. Use 0 to disable the limit.

commands.name: wrap
commands.description: Full pipeline: analyze + package + generate wrapper solution

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the legacy .sln file

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the generated wrapper solution

options.name: --skip-build
options.description: Skip the legacy solution build step

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration

options.name: --remediate
options.description: Auto-remediate known incompatibilities by generating bridge/shim classes

options.name: --rewrite-il
options.description: Rewrite IL in legacy assemblies to redirect blocked API calls to bridge methods (implies --remediate)

options.name: --di-overrides
options.description: Generate DI adapter classes that substitute bridge implementations (implies --remediate)

options.name: --ai-provider

options.name: --ai-api-key
options.description: API key for AI provider (defaults to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY env var)

options.name: --max-projects
options.description: Maximum number of projects for per-project packaging. When exceeded, all assemblies are bundled into a single aggregate NuGet package. Use 0 to disable the limit.
